topic: It's too dark, I'm scared: my child is afraid of the dark at bedtime
video_title: Afraid of the dark at bedtime? What to do for ages 3-6
caption:
"It's too dark, I'm scared" and my child keeps calling me back at bedtime.

Being afraid of the dark is a common childhood fear at ages 1-6 years.
Try a dim light if needed, and listen to the fear instead of brushing it off.
Never laugh at it or push your child to be brave.
Small, calm steps make bedtime feel safer.
